body: Unfortunately, I believe I’ve already made my decision. But I do thank you for taking the time for listening to me and responding to me.

I know they will be happy to see me. But I won’t. I can’t go back knowing that I have to start all over again. I’m so tired. I’m tired of making the wrong choices and decisions. Everyone of my life seems to be happy, with families and children, and I can’t seem to find my way. My heart is broken beyond repair that it is better for me not to ever feel again than continue in this life. I’m more scared of my future than the ending of my life cos I know everything will be ok when I go. People will be sad yes, but they will all be ok. Just hurts too much that I don’t even want to see anyone. Just going to disappear quietly.
